issue_context.title: Svelte 5: Using input inside button leads to compile error
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

The following code,

```svelte
<button>
	<input/>
</button>
```

leads to,

`</button> attempted to close element that was already automatically closed by <input>
`

This code sample might be invalid html but the error also seems to be misleading.

### Reproduction

https://svelte-5-preview.vercel.app/#H4sIAAAAAAAAEy3IQQqAIBAF0Lv8tdBeROgc2aJyAiFH0TEI6e4htHyv4wwXVeilg7dI0JhzhoI8eaDedAlBoaZWjjFmbyKJrWMnJnBuMlnHZvobCjH5cAby0FIavev7AVTjJxFlAAAA

### Logs

_No response_

comments: You shouldn't put `input` elements inside `button` elements as both are interactive and thus won't work correctly in Svelte 5. We should maybe improve the error message though.

@trueadm even if the input is not visible (from an aria and a visual POV)/not interactive to the user and is being used to submit data with forms? 
```svelte
<button>
	Toggle
	<input type="hidden" aria-hidden="true" />
</button>
```

Would this behavior also impact checkboxes that are set up with labels wrapping them?

```svelte
<label>
	Agree to terms and conditions
	<input type="checkbox" />
</label>
```

We can allow hidden inputs, as they are allowed. The problem we have is that we use HTML template cloning, and the browser – being the browser, likes to try and "fix" your bad HTML in certain cases – resulting in a completely broken UI. Fun times.
Labels are supposed to contain inputs, it's one way of associating them with an input. This also works as expected right now.
